judgment.reason: p1 says Ada wears a silver card, and p18 says exactly one of (silver card, amber belt) holds, so the amber belt is false. Then p11 (exactly one of amber belt, violet pin) makes violet pin true; p17 (exactly one of violet pin, scarlet ribbon) makes scarlet ribbon false; p2 (exactly one of scarlet ribbon, scarlet hat) then forces the scarlet hat to be true. Hence 'Ada does not wear a scarlet hat' is false.
